**Findings:** dogfooding: next prints id/title/path only — not the effective score, why it is next, or what blocks it, and there is no one-shot to start it. Consider showing score/blockers (text) and/or a --start flag. · **Size:**  · **Tree:** slicer

## Why

`slicer next` printed only id/title/path — not the effective score, why it's next, or its
status, and there was no one-shot to start it. Filed dogfooding.
